AUDIO TRANSCRIPT
ERA VII
Asterion Flight Operations Engineer
People keep calling this an evacuation fleet. It isn't. We have orbital capacity for thousands. The city outside has millions. Every seat assignment creates ten enemies.
Government wants scientific personnel. Military wants command staff. Aevum wants medical specialists. Asterion wants engineers capable of keeping the stations alive. Continuity wants archive payload.
Families are outside the perimeter begging us to take children. There is no version of this where the rockets save humanity. At best they save a fragment. Maybe a fragment is enough. I don't know.
Launch Window Four opens in six hours. We'll launch whoever is on the manifest and remember everyone who wasn't.

AUDIO TRANSCRIPT
ERA VIII
Dr. Elias Thorne
Asterion has accepted the Continuity archive package. Original EP-7 sample. Original PT-9 sample. PolyCore degradation archive. Vale atmospheric models. Aevum APL research.

Somebody objected to taking live biological samples off-world. Reasonable objection. But if we destroy every original specimen, future researchers inherit only evolved Grey Bloom and our incomplete descriptions.
So the samples go. Triple isolation. Mineral and metallic containment. No conventional polymer dependency in the primary barrier. Kel checked it herself.
There is irony in sending the organisms that destroyed our civilization into orbit to preserve the knowledge necessary to understand them. History is rarely courteous enough to avoid irony.
